caption: The drawing depicts four distinct ornate objects arranged vertically on a plain off-white background. At the top is a dark brown object with a circular loop on the right, a straight cylindrical center, and geometric ends with a textured pattern resembling grape clusters. Below it is a decorative chain with a light gold color, featuring two hands at each end, both surrounded by leafy circular frames and connected by a series of interlocking links. The third object is an oval medallion in golden hues, richly textured, with three standing human figures in relief; the leftmost appears to be holding an object, the central figure is flanked by the other two, and there are detailed patterns above their heads and at the base of the medallion. The bottom object is a golden relief showing a two-horse chariot with a reclining figure inside, possibly holding reins, and ornamental details at the wheel and base, with the horses in a dynamic running pose. All objects are rendered in shades of gold and brown, with intricate detailing and shading suggesting metallic surfaces and relief sculpture.
title: Tie-back
